# Seed

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 14 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Supplement retail: seed green on snow, 1000px pills, 32px glass menus, Seed Sans at weight 350.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (every captured surface is public marketing). Themes: light.

Public marketing site at seed.com, captured signed out on 2026-11-19. Probiotic and supplement retail. Light theme only. Desktop innerWidth 1169 and phone innerWidth 390. No account, no bag, no checkout.

Computed styles were read in the T3 preview tab. The preview browser did not produce screenshot frames. Headless Playwright received a Cloudflare challenge, so this package has no screenshots and no crops.

## Typography

10 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Seed Sans.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Seed Sans (300, 350, 400, 500, with italics) and Seed Sans Mono (400) are served from seed.com as woff2 under `/fonts/`. They are proprietary. Tokens name Seed Sans and fall back to Helvetica. That fallback is what [style-guide.html](style-guide.html) can render.

The hero heading stack also names system-ui, "Helvetic Neue", Helvetica, and Arial. "Helvetic Neue" is the spelling in the computed font-family.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

There are no page screenshots. `preview_snapshot` failed with "The browser is not producing screenshot frames." Headless Playwright returned HTTP 403 and the title "Just a moment..." on every public URL, so that route was stopped. The catalog cover is [icon.png](icon.png), a favicon, not a page capture.

Desktop readings are at innerWidth 1169, not 1440. The preview tab was in fill mode. Phone readings are at innerWidth 390 after a freeform resize.

Button height is 52px on the homepage quiz link and 48px on Start Now. Both use radius 1000px and padding 16px 24px. The token records both.

`--text-error` and `--text-warning` are declared. No error or warning message was on screen.

The focused sign-in email computed `outline: none`. A focused header link computed a 3px solid seed-green outline with offset 2.5px. Those are different.

Cookie Settings is a OneTrust control (13px, weight 600, radius 2px, black border). It is not a Seed token.

Weight 350 is Seed Sans Regular. The same woff2 is also declared at weight 400. Body copy computed at 400.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use seed green on snow.** Text is #1c3a13. Page fill is #fcfcf7. The html background on the dark hero is the same green, #1c3a13. See [raw/measurements.md](raw/measurements.md).
- **Set display type in Seed Sans at 350, with tight tracking.** The hero is 48px / 52.8px / -1.2px. Science display is 64px at weight 300 and -2%. Eyebrows are 12px, weight 500, uppercase.
- **Make the action a pill.** Radius 1000px, padding 16px 24px, height 48px or 52px. Filled buttons are seed green with snow text. Inverse buttons are snow with seed-green text.
- **Put menus on frosted glass.** The shop menu and the sign-in panel are rgba(87, 94, 85, 0.35), radius 32px, padding 16px, backdrop blur 19px.
- **Keep the quiz option a 72px card.** Radius 16px, 1px border #d2d8d0, snow fill, 18px label.
- **Do not invent a dark theme.** The stylesheet has no dark palette. Product colours (AM-02, DM-02, PM-02, VS-01) are accents, not a second theme.
- **Do not treat icon.png as a page capture.** It is the site favicon, a green circle, and it is also the catalog cover because there is no screenshot.
